    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    -- build geography point (longitude, latitude)

tracks AS (

  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    SUM(dist_m) AS track_meters
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sid,
      name,
      iso_time,
      geog,
      LAG(geog) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geog,
      IF(prev_geog IS NULL, 0.0, ST_DISTANCE(prev_geog, geog)) AS dist_m
    FROM atl_2020

  GROUP BY sid, name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY track_meters DESC) AS rank_desc
  FROM tracks t
),
second_longest AS (
  SELECT sid, name, track_meters
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rank_desc = 2
),
final_point AS (
  -- get the final (latest) coordinate for that storm
  SELECT a.latitude
  FROM atl_2020 a
  JOIN second_longest s USING(sid)
  WHERE a.rn_desc = 1
)

FROM final_point

-- Identify the third-longest traveling North Atlantic hurricane in 2020 and show its point-by-point coordinates,
-- cumulative travel distance (km) and max sustained wind at each point.
WITH atlantic_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    -- geography point (lon, lat)
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geop
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE
    basin = 'NA'
    AND SAFE_CAST(season AS INT64) = 2020
    -- keep only rows with valid coordinates
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- Order points per storm and compute segment distances between consecutive points
ordered_points AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geop,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM atlantic_2020
),
segments AS (
  SELECT
    cur.sid,
    cur.iso_time,
    cur.latitude,
    cur.longitude,
    cur.usa_wind,
    cur.geop,
    cur.rn,
    -- previous point geop for distance calc
    prev.geop AS prev_geop,
    -- distance in meters between this point and previous point; NULL for first point
    CASE
      WHEN prev.geop IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ST_DISTANCE(prev.geop, cur.geop)
    END AS segment_meters
  FROM ordered_points cur
  LEFT JOIN ordered_points prev
    ON cur.sid = prev.sid
    AND cur.rn = prev.rn + 1
),
-- cumulative distance per storm (meters) and keep per-point cumulative
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    segment_meters,
    -- cumulative sum of segment meters ordered by rn (first point will be segment_meters=0)
    SUM(segment_meters) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_meters
  FROM segments
),
-- compute total travel distance per storm (meters)
totals AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    MAX(cumulative_meters) AS total_meters
  FROM cumulative
  GROUP BY sid
),
-- find the storm with the 3rd longest total distance (tie-break by sid)
third_longest AS (
  SELECT sid
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sid,
      total_meters,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_meters DESC, sid) AS rn_desc
    FROM totals
  )
  WHERE rn_desc = 3
)
-- final output: all points for that storm with cumulative distance in kilometers and max sustained wind
SELECT
  c.iso_time,
  c.latitude,
  c.longitude,
  ROUND(c.cumulative_meters / 1000, 3) AS cumulative_km,
  c.usa_wind AS max_sustained_wind_kt
FROM cumulative c
JOIN third_longest t
  ON c.sid = t.sid
ORDER BY c.iso_time

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(start_station_id AS STRING) AS station_id,
    starttime AS start_ts,
    stoptime AS stop_ts,
    bikeid,
    usertype,
    birth_year,
    gender
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id IS NOT NULL
    AND end_station_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Identify candidate group departures: trips that start at same station within 2-minute window
start_groups AS (
  SELECT
    t1.station_id,
    t1.start_ts,
    t1.stop_ts,
    t1.bikeid,
    COUNTIF(ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t1.start_ts, t2.start_ts, SECOND)) <= 120) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.station_id, t1.start_ts ORDER BY t1.start_ts RANGE BETWEEN 120 PRECEDING AND 120 FOLLOWING) AS start_neighbors
  FROM trips t1
  JOIN trips t2
  ON t1.station_id = t2.station_id
),
-- Identify candidate group arrivals: trips that end at same station within 2-minute window
arrivals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(end_station_id AS STRING) AS station_id,
    stoptime AS stop_ts,
    starttime AS start_ts,
    bikeid
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE end_station_id IS NOT NULL
),
arrival_groups AS (
  SELECT
    a1.station_id,
    a1.stop_ts,
    a1.start_ts,
    a1.bikeid,
    COUNTIF(ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a1.stop_ts, a2.stop_ts, SECOND)) <= 120) OVER (PARTITION BY a1.station_id, a1.stop_ts ORDER BY a1.stop_ts RANGE BETWEEN 120 PRECEDING AND 120 FOLLOWING) AS arrival_neighbors
  FROM arrivals a1
  JOIN arrivals a2
  ON a1.station_id = a2.station_id
),
-- A trip is considered part of a group ride if:
-- 1) it starts and ends at the same station, and
-- 2) it has at least one other trip starting within 2 minutes at that station (start_neighbors >= 2),
--    and at least one other trip ending within 2 minutes at that station (arrival_neighbors >= 2).
same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    s.start_ts,
    s.stop_ts,
    s.bikeid
  FROM trips s
  JOIN arrivals a
    ON s.start_ts = a.start_ts AND s.stop_ts = a.stop_ts AND s.bikeid = a.bikeid
  WHERE s.station_id = a.station_id
),
start_counted AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    sg.start_neighbors
  FROM same_station_trips s
  LEFT JOIN start_groups sg
    ON s.station_id = sg.station_id AND s.start_ts = sg.start_ts AND s.bikeid = sg.bikeid
),
full_counted AS (
  SELECT
    sc.*,
    ag.arrival_neighbors
  FROM start_counted sc
  LEFT JOIN arrival_groups ag
    ON sc.station_id = ag.station_id AND sc.stop_ts = ag.stop_ts AND sc.bikeid = ag.bikeid
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    -- trip is part of a group if there are >= 2 trips within 2 minutes (including itself)
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(start_neighbors,1) >= 2 AND COALESCE(arrival_neighbors,1) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_group_trip
  FROM full_counted
),
station_totals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(end_station_id AS STRING) AS station_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_end_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE end_station_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY station_id
),
station_group_counts AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    SUM(is_group_trip) AS group_trip_count
  FROM labeled
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT
  s.station_id,
  st.name AS station_name,
  COALESCE(g.group_trip_count, 0) AS group_trip_count,
  COALESCE(t.total_end_trips, 0) AS total_end_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(g.group_trip_count, 0), NULLIF(t.total_end_trips, 0)) AS group_proportion
FROM station_totals t
LEFT JOIN station_group_counts g
  ON t.station_id = g.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` st
  ON t.station_id = st.station_id
ORDER BY group_proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Compute total distance traveled per bike by summing great-circle distances between trip start and end stations.
WITH stations AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) AS lat,
    CAST(longitude AS FLOAT64) AS lon
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations`
),
trips AS (
  SELECT
    bike_number,
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE
    bike_number IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id IS NOT NULL
    AND end_station_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POW(SIN(RADIANS(s2.lat - s1.lat) / 2), 2) +
        COS(RADIANS(s1.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(s2.lat)) *
        POW(SIN(RADIANS(s2.lon - s1.lon) / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) AS total_meters
FROM
  trips t
JOIN
  stations s1
ON
  t.start_station_id = s1.station_id
JOIN
  stations s2
ON
  t.end_station_id = s2.station_id
GROUP BY
  t.bike_number
ORDER BY
  total_meters DESC

  '2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31' AS comparison_period,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN iso_week_year = 2019 THEN combined_weekly_sum END), 6) AS combined_average_weekly_search_frequency_2019,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN iso_week_year = 2020 THEN combined_weekly_sum END), 6) AS combined_average_weekly_search_frequency_2020,

SELECT
  TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(TargetCompID, ''), 1, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(TargetCompID, ''), 1, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(TargetCompID, ''), 1, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS algorithm,
  Symbol AS symbol,
  LastPx AS openPrice,
  StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  side_info.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE
    WHEN side_info.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1
    WHEN side_info.Side = 'LONG' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM (
  SELECT
    TradeReportID,
    MaturityDate,
    TargetCompID,
    Symbol,
    LastPx,
    StrikePrice,
    Sides
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`
  WHERE StrikePrice IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY StrikePrice DESC
  LIMIT 6
) t,
UNNEST(COALESCE(t.Sides, [])) AS side_info
